title: The `context` package: cancellation, deadlines and values

videos.script: Lesson 6 stopped goroutines with a channel you close by hand. The context package is that idea with a standard shape. {{tree}} A context has a Done channel and an Err that says why it closed. Contexts form a tree. Background is the root, and every With function makes a child. {{cancel}} You start two workers, one on a context and one on its child. One call to cancel stops both. The parent is never touched. {{deadline}} Then a budget. A lookup that needs three hundred milliseconds gets one hundred. It gives up on time, the error says deadline exceeded, and a cause of your own says which budget ran out. go vet refuses a cancel function you throw away. {{values}} Last, values. A request id rides along with the context, under a key type nobody else can name. And a short list of what does not belong there. {{close}} Lesson 11 passes the context through a whole program.
